assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: crisp high-resolution portrait photograph for a hospital website navigation image card. Create a DIFFERENT Indian woman specialist doctor, about 45 years old, with shoulder-length dark hair tied loosely back, no glasses, calm natural friendly expression, white coat over a pale blue blouse, stethoscope. She is photographed in a real ordinary Indian hospital consultation room near a window, simple off-white paint, pale grey equipment shelving subtly defocused, no other people. Authentic editorial healthcare photography, realistic skin pores, fine flyaway hair, normal clothing creases, restrained neutral daylight, no artificial retouching, CGI, plastic skin, overly perfect symmetry, polished luxury corridor or golden/yellow lighting. Fine photographic detail, sharp eyes and face, natural lens depth of field. Portrait 2:3 at high resolution. No hospital brand text or badges, no watermark, no UI overlays.
